roles.sol: Session manager: maximizes outcome with the lowest reasonable token consumption; uses deep reasoning and reviewers only when complexity or risk warrants it.
roles.agy: Default executor for operational analysis, filesystem, worktrees, CLI, tests, and local code changes. Does not perform live changes to n8n workflows.
roles.luna: Dedicated executor for live n8n workflow changes via the MCP server. Inspects first, applies targeted changes, validates, and reports outcome.
roles.deepseek_pro: Independent reviewer: reserved for architectural decisions, migrations, or risks that Sol cannot resolve with direct evidence.
roles.deepseek_flash: Cost-effective fixer for focused technical corrections; steps in when AGY encounters logic, backend, or test issues. Does not replace Luna on live n8n.
roles.glm_flash: Cost-effective fixer for frontend/UI, CSS, client JavaScript, documentation, and contracts; steps in when AGY fails in these areas. Not a reviewer.

light.description: Sol + agy + Luna n8n (essential, reviewers only if Sol requests them)

standard.description: Base session: Sol manages, agy executes, Luna modifies n8n via MCP; selective reviewers decided by Sol

critical.description: Sol + agy + Luna; DeepSeek Pro only if Sol requests rare architectural review

luna_flash.description: Sol + Luna n8n via MCP with DeepSeek Flash as cost-effective fallback

sol_pro.description: Sol (GPT-5.6 Sol) + DeepSeek Pro + agy (thorough architectural review)

quick.description: Sol (low effort) + agy (quick targeted fixes, bounded budget)

mechanical.description: Deterministic/mechanical task (zero LLM for preflight/allowlisted export, zero Sol)
